evd_title: Human review weakness diversity ITF-IDF was 7.69 while best LLM GPT-4o scored only 5.95 on AAAR PaperWeakness task
finding: Human review weakness diversity ITF-IDF was 7.69 while best LLM GPT-4o scored only 5.95 on AAAR PaperWeakness task
P: 993 ICLR 2023 papers with multi-reviewer weakness lists (AAAR-1.0 Weakness task)
I: 10 LLMs (GPT-4o, Claude 3.5 Sonnet, Gemini 1.5 Pro, o1-preview, o3-mini, open-source) + AI-SCI, zero-shot, split-combine full text
C: Human ICLR 2023 reviewer weaknesses; other LLMs; AI-SCI agent (GPT-4o)
O: ITF-IDF diversity: humans 7.69 vs GPT-4o 5.95 (best LLM); S-F1 GPT-4o 47.73%; AI-SCI 2.23
